title: Packet volume: one over q
spoken: Packet volume scales by inverse q.
explanation: The volume of the bounded piece of light changes by one over q. Its surface travels with the light, so this is not the material contraction by gamma: at q = 0.5 the volume doubles.
assumptions: The moving system moves along x at speed v relative to the stationary system, with |v| < c. Modern teaching notation: gamma is the paper's beta, c its V.
A bounded piece of plane light whose surface moves with the light. q is the frequency ratio of section 7 for this light's direction.
Energy density, volume and total energy are three different quantities, and each has its own factor.

notes.title: One over q
notes.explanation: The volume changes the opposite way to the frequency. Using gamma here, as for a rod, gives the wrong total energy.

notes.title: Moving over stationary
notes.explanation: How the volume changes between the systems.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: The volume of this particular region, whose boundary moves with the light.

notes.title: The frequency ratio
notes.explanation: Section 7's q, for this light's direction. At 0.6c, for light along the motion, q = 0.5.

notes.title: Packet volume, stationary system
